response.text:
India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar kai behtareen face wash available hain jo excess oil ko control karte hain aur pores ko clean rakhte hain. Yahan kuch top options diye gaye hain:

Ye Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash oily aur acne-prone skin ke liye ek **great gel-based cleanser** hai jo extra oil ko control karne aur pores ko unclog karne mein madad karta hai.

Ye Sebamed Gentle Facial Cleanser for Oily & Combination Skin skin ke natural barrier ko maintain rakhte hue **excess sebum ko effectively remove** karta hai.

Ye Chemist At Play 2% Salicylic Acid Oil & Acne Control Face Wash active acne aur excess oil ko target karta hai aur **skin inflammation ko soothe** karta hai.

Ye Himalaya Neem Purifying Face Wash neem aur turmeric ke sath aata hai jo **excess oil aur impurities ko saaf karke** breakouts ko roakta hai.

Ye mCaffeine Naked & Raw Coffee Face Wash pure arabica coffee ke sath skin ko deep clean karta hai aur **hydration ko balance rakhte hue freshness** deta hai.
